name: Gam A Melodic Minor
use_when: Chọn gam / scale để ngẫu hứng jazz
avoid_when: Đệm hát ballad Việt — đây là gam jazz, không phải bài của thầy Hải Joseph

output.source_text: The Jazz Melodic Minor Scale raises the 6th and 7th degrees of the Natural Minor scale (or a Major scale with a flat 3rd). Unlike classical music, in jazz the raised 6th and 7th degrees remain raised both ascending and descending (e.g., A Melodic Minor: A-B-C-D-E-F#-G#-A).

note_vi: Bài 8 của nguồn Jazz Scales (YouTube), mốc 01:30-02:50. The Jazz Melodic Minor Scale raises the 6th and 7th degrees of the Natural Minor scale (or a Major scale with a flat 3rd). Unlike classical music, in jazz the raised 6th and 7th degrees remain raised both ascending and descending (e.g., A Melodic Minor: A-B-C-D-E-F#-G#-A).
